$comment: Approved open-campus intro media on alpha.school campus pages. The intro card slot is Elementor path /2/elements/1/elements/1 (image) or the video widget beside it. Cards are "<id>-<Campus>-Open-and-Enrolling.png" made by Yash Chitneni from one template (uploaded 2026-09-07). A row records the approval only: openMedia (card, video or null = no approved asset yet; ask the owner, never substitute), attachmentId, status (placed or missing), owner, state, evidence and addedBy. What the slot shows today is never written here: free-text descriptions rot (the Atlanta note of 2026-09-15 outlived the asset it described); the observer packet (sources.json media, vision.json) describes the slot and tests/site-truth-report.mjs grades it from that observation, with this registry contributing the approval alone. Waitlist cards (MacKenzie Price 2026-10-05, tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-10-05-campus-enrollment-state-48a1221b.json): a waitlist campus's intro card is "<slug>-waitlist-2026-27.png", alt "Apply for Waitlist — 2026–27 school year", made by Yash Chitneni and uploaded 2026-10 (attachments 12506-12511). cardVariant names which card a row approves (open-and-enrolling or waitlist-2026-27) so the two are never confused; the enrollment state itself lives in registry/campus-enrollment-state.json, not here.
owner: Yash Chitneni (WordPress user 30) produces Open and Enrolling cards; Matt/Yash approve campus videos

template.$comment: The one master every Open and Enrolling card is generated from (QC loop repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 5). source is the file Yash supplies (an APEX asset id or a path under tests/fixtures is fine); format is svg or png+layout; null = not supplied yet, so nothing can be generated for production and every missing card stays a Missing Info ask to the owner. The generator is agent/generate-open-card.mjs, the only production path is protocols/recipes/open-card.md, and the fixture is a plain placeholder for the tests, never a card for a page.
template.ask: Yash: please supply the Open and Enrolling card master with the campus name replaced by the literal text {{CAMPUS}}, as an SVG export of the design (fonts outlined or embedded; preferred), or as the flat PNG without the name plus the name's text layout (x, y baseline, font, size, colour, max width, alignment) in template pixels. Attach it to the card batch ticket in APEX or post it in #support-websites. The agent then generates each campus's card with agent/generate-open-card.mjs (protocols/recipes/open-card.md), you approve the first three generated cards, and only then is any card placed.
